title: Beyond Discrete Tokens: Preserving Numerical Continuity in Medical Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.32948v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Objective: To develop a unified vision-language model for prompt-conditioned quantitative ultrasound measurement that addresses the mismatch between continuous measurement targets and discrete token-based numerical prediction. Methods: This article presents HAD-VLM, a hybrid autoregressive-diffusion framework that combines autoregressive text generation with continuous measurement prediction within a shared backbone. Visual prompt tuning adapts the vision encoder to ultrasound images. A diffusion process predicts a five-component representation comprising caliper endpoint coordinates and measurement length. A post-processing strategy combining the proposed coordinate-length consistency mechanism with ensemble prediction is introduced to refine measurement estimates. We evaluate four echocardiographic measurement tasks on EchoNet-LVH, with additional assessments of medical question answering and X-ray vertebral measurement. Results: HAD

translated_title: 超越离散标记：在医学视觉-语言模型中保持数值连续性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.32948v1，公告类型：交叉（cross）。目标：开发一个统一的视觉-语言模型，用于基于提示条件的定量超声测量，以解决连续测量目标与基于离散标记的数值预测之间的不匹配问题。方法：本文提出 HAD-VLM，一种混合自回归-扩散框架，在共享骨干网络中将自回归文本生成与连续测量预测相结合。视觉提示调优使视觉编码器适配超声图像。扩散过程预测一个由卡尺端点坐标和测量长度组成的五分量表示。提出一种结合坐标-长度一致性机制与集成预测的后处理策略，用于优化测量估计。我们在 EchoNet-LVH 上评估了四项超声心动图测量任务，并对医学问答和 X 射线椎体测量进行了额外评估。结果：HAD（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 HAD-VLM，一种在共享骨干中融合自回归文本生成与扩散式连续测量预测的混合医学视觉-语言模型，通过扩散过程直接预测卡尺端点坐标与测量长度等连续数值，解决了传统离散标记预测与连续测量目标之间的根本不匹配问题。
en_tdlr: HAD-VLM is a hybrid autoregressive-diffusion medical vision-language model that preserves numerical continuity by predicting continuous ultrasound measurements (caliper endpoint coordinates and lengths) via a diffusion process, resolving the fundamental mismatch between discrete token-based prediction and continuous measurement targets.
